## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the applicable requirement or issue.

## Validation

Describe the checks performed and any remaining limitations. Assess whether a meaningful regression test is needed.

## Documentation site

Describe which user/developer guides and beginner steps this behavior change affects.
Update them in this PR, or explain why no documentation-site update is needed.
Reviewers must verify this assessment.

## Compatibility

Note changes to persisted data, plan exchange or installation. App and integration share one release version.
